kill.statedBound: up to METER_FLUSH_CALLS calls or METER_FLUSH_SECONDS of calls per rollup document per instance (SIGTERM flushes first; a hard kill does not)

extraWritesPerRequest.batched: ≤ 2 per (organization, day) and (organization, user, day) document per flush; with METER_FLUSH_CALLS = 100 that is ≤ 0.02 per request for a single user
